Communications
Notifications

Configure which notifications are sent automatically and which require manual sending.

Test connection
Channels

How the clinic reaches patients: the channel automatic messages use and the Send buttons staff see.

Preferred channel
Email
Used for automatic messages (new booking, reminder, welcome…).

Fall back to the other channel

If the preferred channel cannot send, try the other available channel instead of skipping the message.

SMS daily limit
Max outbound SMS per day for the clinic.

Show a Send button for…

Which Send buttons reception sees on appointments, quotes and invoices.

Email
WhatsApp
SMS

WhatsApp is not available until the clinic's number is connected. Connect WhatsApp (Kapso)

SMS is not available until an SMS provider is configured. Configure

Automatic vs manual notifications

Define which notifications are sent automatically when an event occurs and which require the user to send them manually.

Notification type	Enabled	Auto send	Options


Appointment confirmation

Confirmation email when an appointment is scheduled

	
	
	-


Appointment cancellation

Notification email when an appointment is cancelled

	
	
	-


Appointment reminder

Reminder email before the appointment

	
	
	
h before



Quote sending

Email with quote details

	
	
	-


Quote accepted

Confirmation email when a quote is accepted

	
	
	-


Welcome

Welcome email for new patients

	
	
	-


Invoice sending

Message with the invoice when it is sent to the patient

	
	
	-


Quote reminder

Follow-up for quotes with no reply (7 and 14 days)

	
	
	-


Recall reminder

Reminder to book the periodic follow-up visit

	
	
	-

Information

Auto send: The notification is sent when the event occurs (e.g., when creating an appointment).
Manual send: A button will appear to send the notification when desired.
Disabled: The notification will not be sent and the send option will not appear.
Email server configuration
Configure
Not configured

Configure the SMTP server to send emails from your clinic. Each clinic can have its own configuration.
